title: Boeing's MAX Headache, United's Starlink Sprint, and BA Builds a Flying Business Class Mansion
summary: Southwest and United just told Boeing "no thanks" to new 737 MAXs over a software glitch, and it's a bad look at the worst possible time. Plus, United is racing to slap Starlink on a thousand jets before Delta gets off the ground, British Airways reveals a wild new A380 cabin, and three airlines just discovered the same tiny Arizona town at once.
